title: Office Manager
description:
Full\-time  

Hybrid \| Mars Hill, North Carolina


$52,000 – $60,000 \+ benefits (details below)


About Us
The Ammortal Chamber brings together multiple scientifically backed technologies into one experience. It is a healing technology that can be utilized by wellness clinics and inside the home. Our clients include specialty spas and clinics, sports teams, and individuals who are biohackers or athletes.


We are a small team with a startup culture. After our first full year shipping a finished product on the market, we’ve shown strong growth. Our team is made up of engineers, health professionals, and startup entrepreneurs.


As we continue expanding, this role offers hands\-on experience, opportunities to grow into leadership, and the chance to make a tangible impact by developing and delivering cutting\-edge wellness technology. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to innovate and shape technologies that enhance well\-being for our clients.


What is this role and why does it exist?
Ammortal is scaling rapidly, from 114 chambers shipped in 2025 to over 230 planned for 2026, and our Mars Hill facility is the operational center of gravity. As our team grows and production volume increases, we require someone who owns the day\-to\-day functioning of this space: keeping it organized, well\-supplied, and running smoothly so that our manufacturing, supply chain, and operations teams can focus on building and shipping chambers.


The Office Manager is the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks at the office level. You'll manage the physical workspace, coordinate with vendors, support onsite team logistics, and serve as the go\-to person for anything the Mars Hill team needs to do their best work. This role is foundational; it's about creating the conditions for a high\-performing team to thrive in a fast\-moving environment.

  

Responsibilities* **Office Operations \& Maintenance:** Own the daily operation of the Mars Hill office. Ensure the workspace is clean, organized, safe, and fully functional. Coordinate maintenance, repairs, and cleaning. Manage relationships with building management, cleaning services, and maintenance vendors.
* **Supplies \& Inventory Management:** Manage procurement of office supplies, breakroom essentials, cleaning products, and general facility consumables.
* **Vendor \& Service Provider Coordination:** Serve as the primary point of contact for facility\-related vendors: janitorial, HVAC, internet/telecom, security, and any other service providers. Manage contracts, schedules, and service quality.
* **Onsite Team Support:** Be the go\-to resource for the Mars Hill team. Support onboarding logistics for new hires (workspace setup, building access, equipment). Coordinate team lunches, meetings, and facility\-related events. Manage visitor access and guest coordination for partner and team visits.
* **Mail, Shipping \& Receiving:** Handle incoming and outgoing mail and packages for the office (non\-production shipments). Coordinate with carriers for office\-related deliveries.
* **Safety \& Compliance:** Ensure the facility meets local health, safety, and fire code requirements. Maintain safety supplies (first aid kits, fire extinguishers, signage). Support any facility\-related compliance documentation. Coordinate with leadership on workplace safety initiatives.
* **Administrative Support:** Provide general administrative support to the operations and leadership teams as needed.


Skills to Excel* Proactive Problem\-Solving: You notice things before they become problems. A leaky faucet, a low supply shelf, a vendor contract coming up for renewal, you handle it before anyone has to ask. In a scaling production environment, this anticipation is critical.
* Organizational Rigor: You thrive on systems and checklists. Managing multiple vendors, supply schedules, and office needs requires someone who keeps everything tracked and nothing slips. You bring order to complexity.
* Clear Communication: You communicate directly and professionally with vendors, team members, and leadership. You know when to escalate, when to handle something yourself, and how to keep the right people informed without creating noise.
* Vendor Management: You can manage service providers, hold them accountable, negotiate fair terms, and know when it's time to switch.
* Startup Adaptability: This isn't a corporate office with a facilities department down the hall. You'll wear multiple hats, figure things out on the fly, and take ownership of problems that don't have a clear owner yet. You're comfortable with ambiguity and energized by building something.

  

**Requirements**  

  

Qualifications (Must Haves)* 2\+ years of office management, facilities coordination, or administrative operations experience
* Experience managing vendor relationships and service contracts
* Strong organizational skills with a track record of managing multiple priorities simultaneously
* Proficiency with basic office technology (email, spreadsheets, cloud file management)


Qualifications (Nice to Haves)* Basic AI literacy: comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) to draft communications, organize information, or streamline routine administrative tasks
* Experience in a manufacturing, production, or warehouse environment
* Familiarity with workplace safety standards (OSHA basics)
* Experience supporting onboarding or new hire logistics
* Experience working at a startup or high\-growth company
* Familiarity with the Asheville / Western North Carolina area


What Technical Knowledge Do You Need to Perform in This Role?**Required**

* Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, Google Sheets)
* Basic spreadsheet skills for tracking budgets, inventory, and vendor contracts
* Comfort with communication tools (Slack or similar)

**Preferred**

* Notion (Ammortal's primary knowledge base and project management tool)

  

**Benefits**  

  

Pay, Location, Hours* Pay Range: $52,000 – $60,000
* Benefits: 80% of health, dental, and vision insurance covered
* Equity: 15,000 options vesting over 4 years with a 1 year cliff
* Location: On\-site Mars Hill, North Carolina

title: Production Operator (Dayshift)
description:
About PFX™
  
  

We engineer leading fluid solutions that keep the world moving and we’re building a better future while we do it. As a vertically integrated global powerhouse, we operate 17 manufacturing facilities and 4 R\&D centers across the world, delivering performance from lab to road in over 40 countries.
  
  

PFX Group™ brings together a family of trusted companies including Recochem, Prestone, Adam’s Polishes, B\&B Blending, Kost USA, Ultra Clear, POR and Auto\-Chem, each with deep expertise, regional insight, and a shared commitment to engineering excellence.
  
  

From automotive and heavy\-duty thermal management systems to household and industrial solutions, our products are built for performance, reliability, and a commitment to sustainability. Join us and be part of a team that’s redefining what’s possible in fluid technology.
  
  

Job Overview
  
The Production Operator (Dayshift, 6:00am – 2:30pm) is within our Auto/Car Care/Prestone division and is responsible for the daily operations of the filling line production area, ensuring that the shift meets established safety, quality, and production goals in compliance with all applicable company requirements. This role is located at our Alsip, Illinois facility.
  
The expected compensation for this position is an hourly rate of $22\.00 per hour depending on experience and qualifications and is bonus eligible.
  
Your role at Prestone
  
* Responsible for the daily operation and monitoring of a production line, ensuring that the product adheres to Prestone’s standards of safety, quality, and throughput.
* Monitor the production line, observing for issues such as pile\-ups, jams, or defects.
* Stop or reset machines when malfunctions occur, clear jams, and remove defective or substandard materials or products.
* Consistently adheres to Prestone’s Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
* Maintain cleanliness throughout all production areas, including break rooms and restrooms. Process plastic, cardboard, and grind bottles as necessary.
* Maintain quality requirements according to company standards by accurately completing hourly inspection sheets that reflect overall production quality. Be responsible for promptly identifying and reporting any quality defects.
* Identifying unsafe conditions and behaviors while adhering to plant safety regulations, including safe lifting techniques and correct machine handling, is crucial. Personal protective equipment should be worn when necessary.
* Demonstrates the ability and skill to work in all assigned areas of filling production and performs relief duties as needed.


Qualifications
  
* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of two (2\) years manufacturing experience in a machine operator role required.
* Machine troubleshooting.
* Basic math and good communication skills (verbal, written).


**Physical Requirements/Working Conditions:**  

The production facility operates in an industrial setting that combines both indoor and outdoor areas without climate control. A requirement is the capacity to lift to 40 pounds regularly. Duties involve bending, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, twisting, reaching, handling, feeling, seeing, hearing, and remaining in a standing position for extended durations.
  
  

**What We Offer:**  

* Competitive compensation
* Career growth opportunities – we prioritize internal promotions
* Generous 401k match
* Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, vision and dental coverage and Telemedicine
* Paid vacation and holidays
* Tuition assistance program – support for continued education and professional development


**Please note:** A pre\-employment background check, including a criminal record check and drug testing, is required.
  
PFX is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.
  
  

NOTICE TO EMPLOYEES AND APPLICANTS REGARDING THE USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI)
  
  

Our Commitment to Fairness and Transparency
  
The PFX Group may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) or Automated Decision Systems (ADS) to assist in certain employment\-related processes, such as recruitment and hiring. These tools are intended to support decision\-making, not replace human judgment.

Now we’re taking on a bigger challenge: **stopping the new wave of AI\-powered email attacks** hitting organizations today.


Email security is a **$5B\+ market** ripe for disruption. Legacy rule\-based and ML systems can’t keep up with adversaries using AI to craft customized, high\-evasion attacks. AegisAI is building an **LLM\-native email security platform** designed for this new threat landscape.

**The Role**
------------


We’re looking for a **high\-output, curious, and relentless BDR** to help put AegisAI on the map.


Your mission is simple and hard: **create qualified pipeline**. You’ll be the first human touch for many prospects and a critical signal to the market that AegisAI is a serious new player in email security.


You’ll work closely with AEs, founders, and marketing to connect **outbound, inbound, PLG signals, and partner leads** into real sales conversations.


This is not a “follow the script” role. We want AI\-native BDRs who can think, test, adapt, and win.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Generate **net\-new pipeline** through outbound (email, phone, LinkedIn, creative channels)
* Qualify inbound and product\-led signals into **sales\-ready meetings**
* Research target accounts and tailor outreach to **security and IT leaders**
* Clearly articulate why **AI\-native email security** is fundamentally different from legacy tools
* Partner tightly with AEs to convert meetings into real opportunities
* Continuously test messaging, sequences, and targeting — and share what works
* Maintain clean CRM hygiene and accurate pipeline reporting

**Why This Is Hard (and Why It’s Fun)**
---------------------------------------

* You’ll be selling into a **crowded, skeptical security market**
* Buyers are busy, technical, and allergic to fluff
* The product — and the threats — evolve fast


If you like pressure, iteration, and seeing your work turn directly into revenue, you’ll thrive here.

**Why We’ll Win**
-----------------

* Massive, fast\-growing market with incumbents that can’t adapt
* Founders who’ve built **internet\-scale security systems** before
* AI and security are core to the product — not marketing buzzwords
* High bar for talent, low tolerance for politics
* Fast execution and real ownership from day one

--------------------------

* **1–3 years of BDR / SDR experience** in B2B SaaS
* Proven ability to **consistently hit or exceed meeting and pipeline targets**
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfort selling to **technical buyers** (security, IT, engineering)
* Self\-starter who doesn’t wait for perfect instructions
* Coachable, curious, and competitive

**Bonus Points**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you can push the limits of what's possible.


As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Chief Technology Office (CTO) \- Identity \& Access Management (IAM), you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for building critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas working closely with various business functions and partners in support of the firm's business objectives.


You will be responsible for building, integrating, and operating enterprise\-scale automation and an agentic, human\-gated testing ecosystem that accelerates delivery while protecting quality, controls, and auditability. This role will align with user\-journey\-led quality, partner integration readiness, and an agentic test framework. While AI\-enabled IDEs can accelerate test creation, this position exists to engineer what AI alone cannot reliably own in a complex, fast\-changing IAM stack: deterministic test data, stable test environments, integration simulation, coverage integrity, and release\-grade evidence across environments. You will champion end\-to\-end journeys across AuthE Global Product stack, enabling True Continuous Delivery with fast, compliant, evidence\-based releases.




**Job responsibilities**


* Executes creative software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or break down technical problems
* Drives team adoption of enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted engineering practices within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI\-assisted code review/refactoring, test strategy acceleration, incident/root\-cause analysis support), while establishing consistent validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of effective patterns across the team.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
* Set and run journey quality strategy to convert product intent into risk\-based acceptance criteria, measurable quality outcomes, and clear entry/exit standards for key IAM journeys

Design coverages that stays current with maintaining a living journey map (personas flows* tests) and continuously tune regression \& performance testing scope based on change impact and production learnings
* Engineer partner\-facing integration validation by implementing contract tests, stubs/simulators, and automated integration/acceptance suites that emulate partner behaviors and isolate dependency risk
* Identifies opportunities to eliminate or automate remediation of recurring issues to improve overall operational stability of software applications and systems
* Improve reliability of the testing system in reducing flakiness and time\-to\-diagnosis through stability patterns (selectors/fixtures, determinism, parallelism strategy), and clear quarantine/triage rules

Own defect prevention loop to lead reproduction triage fix validation* prevention, feeding failure patterns back into coverage, data strategies, and automation improvements
* Report “journey health” with clarity by providing executive\-ready readiness reporting that explains risk, coverage, and release posture in plain language—backed by evidence, not volume metrics
* Leads communities of practice across Software Engineering to drive awareness and use of new and leading\-edge technologies and must add to team culture of diversity, opportunity, inclusion, and respect




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on software/quality engineering, software development in testing automation concepts and 5\+ years applied experience
* Hands\-on practical experience delivering system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
* Advanced in one or more programming language(s) and framework(s) (i.e., Java, BDD suites \- cucumber/gherkin, SQL, Rest API, Jira, etc.)
* Proficiency hands on engineering, automation depth and continuous delivery methods (UI automation \- playwright/selenium), along with experience in API testing with a track record of building stable suites (selectors/fixtures, reliability patterns, deterministic data, flake control)
* Understands enterprise testing ecosystems with familiarity and ability to standardize across frameworks such as FiTest\+ and/or other harnesses used by the organization (alongside modern OSS stacks)
* Build and operationalize an agentic testing ecosystem to design, implement, and run a human\-gated agent framework that accelerates test authoring, selection, execution, and triage—connecting agents to real tools (frameworks, CI/CD, APIs, data sources) while enforcing guardrails for correctness, determinism, security, and auditability
* Release readiness \& governance with entry/exit criteria, evidence\-based sign\-off, and strong partnership in Release Management in a CD operating model \- along with curate and version a trusted test catalog, continuously measuring agent “fitness” (precision, drift, false positives/negatives), and ensure outputs remain release\-grade across environments
* Establish and maintain strong partnership across Product/Engineering/Operations and other lines of business, with executive\-ready reporting and risk articulation
* Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI\-assisted software development tools (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security
* Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices
* Experience building and operating MCP Servers/clients to connect LLM agents to tools (APIs, databases, and internal services)

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**
* Demonstrate ability to implement human\-in\-the\-loop guardrails to test review standards, signed/versioned catalogs, drift controls, and coverage integrity mechanisms
* Demonstrate proficiency in software applications and technical processes within a technical discipline (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.)
* Experience designing and implementing agentic/LLM\-assisted pipelines for continuous test selection, execution, and reporting across environments, operating MCP Servers/clients to connect LLM agents to tools (APIs, databases, and internal services)

title: Data Scientist, Sales AI
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you interested in shaping the future of Advertising and B2B Sales? We are a growing science and engineering team with an exciting charter and need your passion, innovative thinking, and creativity to help take our products to new heights.  

  

Amazon Advertising is one of Amazon's fastest growing and most profitable businesses, responsible for defining and delivering a collection of advertising products that drive discovery and sales. Our products are strategically important to our businesses driving long term growth. We break fresh ground in product and technical innovations every day!  

  

Within the Advertising Sales organization, we are building a central AI/ML team and are seeking top science talent to build new, science\-backed services to drive success for our customers. Our goal is to transform the way account teams operate by creating actionable insights and recommendations they can share with their advertising accounts, and ingesting Generative AI throughout their end\-to\-end workflows to improve their work efficiency.  

  

As a part of our team, you will bring deep expertise in quantitative modeling (statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, and causal inference) to build and refine models that inform how account teams operate. You will apply generative AI within our ad sales support technologies, and you have the communication skills necessary to explain complex technical approaches to a variety of stakeholders and customers. You will be part of a team of fellow scientists and engineers taking on iterative approaches to tackle big, long\-term problems.  

  

Why you will love this opportunity: Amazon has invested heavily in building a world\-class advertising business. This team defines and delivers a collection of advertising products that drive discovery and sales. Our solutions generate billions in revenue and drive long\-term growth for Amazon's Retail and Marketplace businesses. We deliver billions of ads impressions, millions of clicks daily, and break fresh ground to create world\-class products. We are a highly motivated, collaborative, and fun\-loving team with an entrepreneurial spirit with a broad mandate to experiment and innovate.  

  

Impact and Career Growth: You will invent new experiences and influence customer\-facing shopping experiences; this is your opportunity to work within the fastest growing businesses across all of Amazon! Turn customer needs into data science problems and actionable recommendations for your product, engineering, and sales partners. This role combines analytical rigor, technical strength, product focus, and business understanding.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Build and apply LLM\-based solutions (retrieval\-augmented generation, prompting, and agentic workflows) to solve Ad Sales problems and generate seller\-facing insights and recommendations.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into data science problems, and build the statistical and machine learning models that complement LLM workflows, such as ranking, retrieval evaluation, segmentation, and forecasting.
* Analyze large, complex datasets, including conversation and LLM interaction data, to surface insights, quantify gaps, and identify opportunities to improve our generative AI products.
* Design and run experiments (A/B tests, offline and online evaluations, causal inference) and define metrics that measure the quality, accuracy, and business impact of LLM\-driven solutions.
* Write code (Python, SQL) to acquire, transform, and analyze data at scale, and partner with applied scientists and engineers to move solutions into production.
* Present findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, and mentor junior data scientists on your team.

  

About the team  

Sales AI is a central science and engineering organization within Amazon Advertising Sales that powers selling motions and account team workflows via state\-of\-the\-art of AI/ML services. Sales AI is investing in a range of sales intelligence models, including the development of advertiser insights, recommendations and Generative AI\-powered applications throughout account team workflows.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2\+ years of data scientist experience
* 3\+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
* 3\+ years of machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance experience
* 1\+ years of guiding and coaching a group of researchers experience
* 1\+ years of working with or evaluating AI systems experience
* 1\+ years of creating or contributing to mathematical textbooks, research papers, or educational content experience
* Master's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
* Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Ph.D. in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
* Knowledge of machine learning concepts and their application to reasoning and problem\-solving
* Experience in Python, Perl, or another scripting language
* Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company
* Experience in defining and creating benchmarks for assessing GenAI model performance
* Experience working on multi\-team, cross\-disciplinary projects
* Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data\-driven business decisions
* Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication

Prime Video is seeking a Sr Manager, UX Research to lead a team of researchers delivering impactful, end\-to\-end research that illuminates new insights and opportunities to delight our customers. We need a highly motivated, strategic leader who can lead and mentor a world\-class research team while driving user\-centered design and decision\-making across the organization.

You will be responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive research strategy for your team, guiding them to perform research that creates insightful findings. You will lead your team in daily interactions with product managers, designers, engineers, applied scientists, data scientists, marketing, and research peers to understand and guide research needs across the organization, ensuring research drives meaningful impact as measured by both incremental changes to product design and development roadmaps; as well as influencing product and design visioning investments.

* Proven leadership experience managing and mentoring UX researchers, with a track record of developing talent and building high\-performing teams

* Strategic thinking skills to develop research roadmaps that align with business objectives and product strategy
* Experience establishing research operations, processes, best practices that scale across teams and the ability to evangelize research across the organization
